name: make-skill
description: Create, retrofit, audit, and ship agent skills & Claude Code plugins the proven ssheleg way — spec-conformant, validated, and installable on every agent.

plugins.name: make-skill
plugins.description: Encodes the Agent Skills open standard AND Anthropic's platform rules (front-matter limits, disclosure budgets, per-surface runtime limits, the Skills API, evaluation-driven authoring) plus the Claude Code plugin reference (manifest schemas, component layout, `claude plugin validate --strict`) and the proven ssheleg pipeline: marketplace repo layout, version sync, validator + CI, multi-channel distribution (Claude Code plugin, vercel skills CLI, npx, Cursor), npm gotchas, end-to-end first publish, the review checklist for third-party skills, and MCP / A2A rules for protocol-connected skills.
